3. Issue notice.
Notice is accepted by Mr. Sanjay Pathak, learned Standing Counsel appearing on behalf of Respondent No.1/Union of India.
4. Upon appellant taking steps within 2 weeks, notice be issued to unserved Respondent No.2/SDMC by all permissible modes including electronic mode.

Also, a digital copy of the same be supplied to the learned counsel for the parties, if so requested.
8. Order be uploaded on the website of this Court.
